Открываются .md, .markdown, .mdown, .mkd: Open .md, .markdown, .mdown, .mkd and .txt files up to 20 MB.
Поддерживаются заголовки, выделение текс: Dokvi supports headings, text emphasis, links, images, lists, quotes, tables, tasks, code, footnotes, definitions, subscript, superscript and emoji. LaTeX formulas and Mermaid diagrams work offline. NOTE, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING and CAUTION blocks are also supported.
Изображения из интернета требуют подключ: Online images need an internet connection. Local images load from the document’s folder and its subfolders. Save a new document in the intended folder first.
